messages.text:
The earlier lamp proposal expired before it was paid. Proposals expire 72 hours after creation, so a new one was needed (refund-policy/v2/validity).

A single voucher payment qualifies for automatic payment processing only if it is a valid payment record; your order has one valid payment. Refunds go only to that original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment). They still require your confirmation and staff approval—not payment automatically upon request (refund-policy/v2/approval).

Your new proposal is for **BRL 48.90** (refund-policy/v2/amount). Please confirm using the **button on the proposal card**; a chat message does not count. A staff member will then review it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
